outcome: Classify all 20 required R-037 command cases against the actual local E4B/native route without overstating partial successes, unavailable controls, or unsafe API provisioning.
summary: The source-bound 20-case manifest is complete as a classification artifact, but R-037 is not qualified: several local E4B requests chose the wrong action or lacked the required native consequence/control, a safe stale-target transition was unavailable in the charter, and mandatory same-case gpt-4.1-mini comparisons could not be provisioned without accessing an unsanitized credential exposed by an unrelated process.

accepted_no_replay: Reuse the proved exact-target melee damage and other per-row native successes only at their recorded ceilings.
Do not relabel wrong local actions, missing native consequences, or unavailable material controls as command passes.

first_open_boundary: R-037 cannot be accepted unless a future authorized route supplies safe API credential provisioning and the missing native premises/controls, or the owner changes the frozen outcome in Phase 2.
